name: Move Shiprocket Data to Azure Synapse Analytics
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Shiprocket** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **Azure Synapse** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Shiprocket** account by providing your **API User Email** and **Password** as per the process described [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/shiprocket/setup.html).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/shiprocket/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
